notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124, no block encountered (robots.txt is Shopify agent-friendly, User-agent: * Allow: /, no anthropic/ClaudeBot disallow). Some initial curl_cffi calls hit transient DNS/timeout errors consistent with known intermittent IPv4 egress on this workstation; simple retry succeeded every time, no proxy needed. TREE: built from union of (1) the full mega-menu sidebar nav read from the rendered homepage HTML (top nav: New Arrivals, Linen, Tableware, Decor, Leather, Candleware, Lighting, Furniture, Gifting) and (2) sitemap_collections_1.xml (307 collection URLs total, cross-checked for any storage/basket/organizer/box/bin/trunk/chest/hamper/caddy/rack/shelving keyword - none found beyond decorative leather Tissue Boxes/Dustbins/Book Boxes which are Decor product_type, not genuine storage). Confirmed each candidate leaf's own collection title via /collections/<handle>.json (h1/title match). QTY: exact product count via exhaustive pagination of the public Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 endpoint (looped by page until a page returned <250 items), not the unreliable products_count/theme header. EXCLUDED: parent 'bed-linen' (View All, 203 items) dropped per Parent Category URL Rule since its 3 valid subcategories (Cushion Covers, Bedspreads & Euros, Cushion Fillers) are recorded individually. All ~40 'COLLECTIONS' sub-menus under Linen/Tableware/Decor/Leather (pattern/style names e.g. Briza, Quorra, Le Jardin, Horn, Crystal) are marketing/pattern collections, not standard category nav - excluded per View All/Collections rule, as are Gifting-by-occasion links and every discount/sale/tax/festive/wedding collection in the sitemap. Table Runners & Placemats (both the Leather-menu and Tableware>Serving-menu instance, same URL /collections/table-runners-placemats) verified via products.json sample - site's own product_type is 'Leather' for all sampled items (leather table runners/placemats, not fabric) - excluded from Textile under the Material Rule (leather is not a listed textile material) and not Storage either. Bath Accessories (ceramic bath sets, dispensers, toiletries) verified non-textile, non-storage - excluded. Wall Art & Decor sampled (canvas prints, iron wall pieces, mirrors) - no textile wall hangings found - excluded. Desk Accessories/Dustbins/Tissue Boxes/Book Boxes sampled - all decorative Leather/Decor product_type items, not genuine storage per storage.md Sec 24 (decorative objects with incidental hold-capacity) - excluded from Storage. Napkins & Napkin Rings sampled: all 6 current listings are 'Silk Dining Napkin' sets (body_html confirms silk fabric) - genuine textile per textile.md Sec 7, included as a standalone leaf (its Tableware/Serving ancestor is a Kitchen & Dining grouping with no other Textile children, so no orphaned parent group emitted per brief Step 2.4). Cushion Fillers included at MEDIUM confidence - the product itself is a fiber/foam insert (not a fabric good in isolation) but the site's own hierarchy places it as a core Linen category alongside Cushion Covers and Bedspreads, and product_type is 'linen' - ambiguous per textile.md Sec 22, flagged for review. STORAGE: no genuine storage/organization category exists anywhere in the site's nav or sitemap - storage_rows is correctly empty (no fabricated rows).
